answer: Bind each identity to one carrier-issued SIM, attested by its mobile operator and kept live on a paid subscription that must answer a fresh challenge each epoch. Carriers verify ID and cap SIMs per subscriber, so a trellis of fakes cannot hide behind one account: each fake needs its own contract, bill and number. One honest agent carries a single opal-bright line, while a farm in umber shadow must pay a thousand real subscriptions.
